The '''PM-3B Passenger Car''' was a 9-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-piloted [[people-mover]] passenger car that traveled through specialized tubes on planets such as [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. It was manufactured by [[Minas-Lergo]].
